title: Can maths survive AI? Fields medallist Terence Tao calls for a ‘Maths 2.0’ world
title_zh: 数学能幸存于AI时代吗？菲尔兹奖得主特伦斯·陈呼吁建立“数学2.0”世界
abstract: As machines race ahead in solving problems, mathematicians must establish a new era that prizes human understanding over simply publishing more solutions.
abstract_zh: 随着机器在问题求解方面加速超越人类，数学家必须建立一个新时代，将人类理解置于单纯发布更多解法之上。
snippet: As machines race ahead in solving problems, mathematicians must establish a new era that prizes human understanding over simply publishing more solutions.
